assertions: The response routes to the gdsc sub-skill of drug-molecular-property for a GDSC drug-target lookup.
The response uses the documented query_gdsc("Erlotinib") Python API from sub-skills/gdsc/SKILL.md.
The response reports the screened-compounds match with TARGET EGFR and TARGET_PATHWAY EGFR signaling as documented in the gdsc LLM integration example.
The response describes the JSON return format (source, match_count, matches) from the gdsc SKILL.md return-format block.
The response does not instruct the user to open files from the original DrugClaw/drug_molecular_property checkout.
